edition.publication: American reprint of the Edinburgh edition, revised and chronologically arranged with brief prefaces and occasional notes (Buffalo: Christian Literature Publishing Company, 1886)
edition.title: The Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume VI: Fathers of the Third Century: Gregory Thaumaturgus, Dionysius the Great, Julius Africanus, Anatolius and Minor Writers, Methodius, Arnobius

alternate_titles: Fathers of the Third Century: Gregory Thaumaturgus, Dionysius the Great, Julius Africanus, Anatolius and Minor Writers, Methodius, Arnobius
work.author: Alexander Roberts, James Donaldson, and A. Cleveland Coxe
work.description: The sixth volume of the American Ante-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing Gregory Thaumaturgus (including the Oration and Panegyric Addressed to Origen), Dionysius the Great, Julius Africanus, Anatolius and minor writers, Methodius, and Arnobius in nineteenth-century English translation. Its container identity remains distinct from the ancient works and translated editions printed within it.
work.title: The Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume VI
